transcription_note: Exact published aggregates from evidence/ercot_v1_5_validation.json at source_commit. Row-level predictions, baseline predictions, the model artifact, and the feature table were not in the repository. These values are inputs to the recomputation script. They are not a new run and must not be replaced with simulated numbers.
data_provenance: Official ERCOT system-load archives (NP6-346-CD) joined with pinned Open-Meteo ERA5 weather (four zones, fixed weights from 2019-2024 load). Load segment A: 2019-01-01 to 2024-12-31 (52,602 joined rows). Load segment B: 2026-08-28 to 2026-11-02 23:00 (1,603 joined rows). Pinned ERA5 had not yet published 2026-11-03 at run time, so the six load hours 2026-11-03 00:00-05:00 are unmatched and excluded by the inner join; they lie outside every frozen window and do not affect any reported number. Model and calibration parameters were frozen before the evaluation window was touched.
reproduction: python -m training.ercot.download_historical_weather_period --start 2026-10-31 --end 2026-11-02 --output-dir training_data/ercot_weather_era5_2026; join combined load with the two weather directories (zone weights from <=2024 rows); audit per segment; build features per segment and concatenate to training_runs/ercot_v1/features.csv; python -m training.ercot.train_quantile_model --features training_runs/ercot_v1/features.csv --calibration-mode grid --training-end 2025-01-01 --calibration-start 2026-09-07 --calibration-end 2026-10-04 --evaluation-start 2026-10-05 --evaluation-end 2026-11-01 --model-version ercot-lag-residual-gbt-v1.5-candidate

calibration_coverage_after.note: chosen grid multipliers applied, on the calibration window only

calibration_coverage_before.note: v1.4 fixed shrinkage factors (q50 x0.40, q90 x0.90, q95 x0.90, q99 x0.55) applied to the same calibration-window base offsets

calibration.grid: multiplier in [0.50, 1.50] step 0.01, minimizing |empirical coverage - target coverage| on the calibration window only; ties resolve to the smaller multiplier

published_numeric_gates.requirement: finite outputs for every evaluation row
